Package org.tasktide.core.model.task.job_env

Class HostMetrics

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.core.model.task.job_env.HostMetrics
public class HostMetrics extends Object
Data class for host metrics, internal builder fetches any null records, and data class has method for updating same metrics through MetricsFetcher
